nodes.description: Private owner address set in constructor; used as the privileged authority for init, _mints, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated with raw arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of approvals; written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Whitelist mapping toggled true by _mints; bypasses sale-limit checks in ensure.
Per-address counter of transfers used by condition to enforce per-wallet sale counts.
Global allowed number of sales per address, set by init.
Minimum transfer amount, set by init, enforced in condition.
Maximum transfer amount, set by init, enforced in condition.
Whitelisted trading address, set by setTradeAddress and trusted by ensure.
Total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance checks and balance transfers.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
Public payable transfer entry point performing allowance, whitelist and balance updates with unchecked arithmetic.
Internal whitelist gate that approves owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise calls condition.
Public payable approval writer for allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal sale-limit policy check reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Privileged minting function callable by owner or a hardcoded address; also whitelists spender via canSale.
Owner-only initializer for _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale sale parameters.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total with unchecked multiplication and subtraction.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure CREATE2 address computation used to derive the Uniswap pair address in ensure.
Payable constructor setting metadata, totalSupply, owner and a max allowance to the UNI router.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary attacker-controlled address with arbitrary calldata, executed in the contract context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath inside transferFrom.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total performed without SafeMath inside batchSend.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the implicit sender when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
transfer calls transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
msg.sender drives the allowance decrement and the owner whitelist comparison in transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances.
ensure falls through to condition when no whitelist entry matches.
User-supplied _from is compared against owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress and canSale whitelists.
ensure's _from parameter is the value used in the whitelist branch.
transferFrom amount flows into ensure for limit validation.
ensure's _value is forwarded to condition for min/max sale checks.
condition's _from indexes the _onSaleNum mapping.
_onSaleNum is read to enforce the per-address sale count.
_saleNum is read to determine whether sale-count limits apply.
_minSale is read to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
_maxSale is read to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
condition's boolean result gates whether transferFrom is allowed to move tokens.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
balanceOf is read to validate the sender has sufficient funds.
balanceOf is written for both sender and recipient using raw arithmetic.
transferFrom increments the per-address sale counter _onSaleNum.
allowance is read to verify the spender is authorized for the amount.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decremented without SafeMath.
canSale[_from] grants an unconditional whitelist bypass inside ensure.
msg.sender is the approval owner written by approve.
approve overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate requires msg.sender to equal owner before executing arbitrary delegatecall.
Stored owner is the reference value compared against msg.sender in delegate.
delegate invokes the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Attacker-supplied target address a is the destination of the delegatecall.
Attacker-supplied calldata b is executed by the delegatecall in this contract's context.
delegatecall executes untrusted code in the contract's storage context, allowing reentrancy into transferFrom state updates.
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
Stored owner is compared against msg.sender in _mints.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with an arbitrary value.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting whitelist privileges.
init is gated on msg.sender == owner.
Owner storage variable is the authority checked by init.
init writes the global _saleNum limit.
init writes _minSale derived from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale derived from the maxToken parameter.
batchSend is gated on msg.sender == owner.
Owner is the authority checked at the start of batchSend.
Recipient array _tos is iterated during the distribution loop.
Per-recipient _value is used to compute the batch total and credited balances.
Locally computed total feeds the unchecked balance subtraction in batchSend.
batchSend executes balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total without SafeMath.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for sender and each recipient.
setTradeAddress is gated on msg.sender == owner.
Owner storage is compared against msg.sender in setTradeAddress.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
tradeAddress is a trusted sender in the ensure whitelist check.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address used for whitelisting.
Locally derived pair address _UNI is compared against _from in ensure.
msg.sender becomes the privileged owner during construction.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply parameter.
Constructor grants the UNI router an unlimited allowance.
Hardcoded UNI router constant is used for the constructor's unlimited allowance grant.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient argument of transfer and carries no independent security semantics.
_value is a transient argument of transfer forwarded to transferFrom.
_from is consumed by transferFrom's allowance and whitelist checks.
_to is only used as the balance recipient inside transferFrom.
_value is the transient amount processed by transferFrom.
_spender is a transient index for the allowance write in approve.
_value is the transient allowance amount written by approve.
_from is only used to index _onSaleNum inside condition.
_value is a transient bound compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
a is the transient delegatecall target supplied to delegate.
b is the transient calldata supplied to the delegatecall in delegate.
spender is a transient recipient mutated by _mints.
addedValue is the transient balance value written by _mints.
saleNum is a transient configuration value stored by init.
token is a transient value converted into _minSale by init.
maxToken is a transient value converted into _maxSale by init.
_tos is the transient recipient array iterated by batchSend.
_value is the transient per-recipient amount used by batchSend.
total is the intermediate value that directly feeds the unchecked balance subtraction.
i is a purely local loop counter with no security relevance.
_to is a loop-local copy of an entry of _tos.
addr is the transient value assigned to tradeAddress.
pair is the computed return value local to pairFor.
_supply is a transient constructor argument scaled into totalSupply.
ensure's _from is the transient address used in the whitelist comparison.
ensure's _to is the transient address compared against owner.
ensure's _value is the transient amount forwarded to condition.
_UNI is the locally derived pair address used only within ensure's whitelist check.
